task: Reverse the list (list 1 2 3) using the built-in reverse function; store the result via (rlm-set answer ...) then (rlm-set Final true).
lesson: Today I learned `rlm-set` requires a non-nil value, and storing `nil` caused the verify gate to reject the answer.
